question: What kind of substances are separated using the technique of steam distillation?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Substances that are steam volatile.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• Steam distillation is employed for those **liquids which are insoluble in water, contain non-volatile impurities, and are steam volatile**.
 
• Steam distillation is widely used in the manufacturing of **essential oils, for instance, perfumes.**
 
• This method uses a plant material that consists of **essential oils.**
 
• **Mainly orange oil** is extracted on a large scale in industries using this method.
 
• Steam distillation is used for **the isolation of antioxidant and antimicrobial compounds from herbs and species such as clove, rosemary, sage, and thyme.**

 [IMAGE: https://encrypted-tbn0.gstatic.com/images?q=tbn:ANd9GcQfTZzA52zhiv52LecjQAnzB-ajFU9hG67IwQ&usqp=CAU] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Coloured components** of a mixture can be separated by a technique called **chromatography**.​ 
 
• **Charge-induced separation** occurs when a charged object is brought close to a neutral one.
 
• **The coarse substance** is **chalk powder**. The powder increases the friction between the bar and the gymnast's hands.
